name: Learning English With Takako
source: Inspired by the SeaBed visual novel created by Paleontology. Set before the prologue of the visual novel we have Sachiko and Takako practicing their English in anticipation for their upcoming trip to the southern islands of Australia. A peek into the lives of Sachiko and Takako in this fan visual novel.
translation: 灵感来自Paleontology创作的SeaBed视觉小说。在视觉小说的序幕之前，幸子和贵子练习英语，期待即将到来的澳大利亚南部岛屿之旅。在这部粉丝视觉小说中一睹幸子和贵子的生活。
